item.statement: The complexity of the alloy composition prevents a complete deconvolution of all individual relaxation processes contributing to the damping peaks.
quotes: Because of the complexity in alloy composition and the resulting multitude in local chemical environments in which the interstitial atoms switch their positions, it is difficult to conduct a complete peak deconvolution analysis based on all possible individual relaxation processes.
Because of the complicated occupation of the Ta, Nb, Hf, Zr, and Ti elements in the current HEAs, it is difficult to determine the actual clusters attributing to these two peaks.

item.statement: While nitrogen doping significantly increases yield strength, the formation of ordered nitrogen complexes is limited, resulting in lower ductility enhancement compared to oxygen doping.
quotes: Interstitial reinforcement by nitrogen is more effective than that conveyed by oxygen doping.
Hence, only ~5.3% of all the nitrogen atoms in the N-2 HEA contribute to the formation of ordered nitrogen complexes.
In addition, the ductility of the N-2 HEA (~11.9%) was not obviously deteriorated because of the formation of the limited ordered nitrogen complexes, in comparison to the base HEA.

item.statement: There is a trade-off between maximizing damping capacity (via random interstitials) and maximizing ductility (via ordered complexes), as the mechanisms rely on different distributions of interstitial atoms.
item.lever: distribution of interstitial atoms (ordered vs. random)
quotes: This analysis shows that ordered interstitial complexes contribute to the enhancement of ductility while randomly distributed interstitial atoms improve mechanical damping.
The addition of 2.0 at % oxygen enhances not only the yield strength to ~1138 MPa but also the maximum damping ability to ~0.020 at 1.0 Hz.
The oxygen atoms (~18.5%) induce the formation of ordered interstitial complexes, which greatly benefit the plastic deformation and increase the ductility to ~20%.

item.statement: The authors attempted to fully deconvolute the relaxation structure into all possible individual processes but found it impossible due to the high variety of local configurations.
quotes: Because of the complexity in alloy composition and the resulting multitude in local chemical environments in which the interstitial atoms switch their positions, it is difficult to conduct a complete peak deconvolution analysis based on all possible individual relaxation processes.

However, two main configurations of the interstitial atoms can indeed be distinguished in the current material, namely, position switches of interstitials in ordered interstitial complexes and relaxation of randomly distributed interstitial atoms.
Therefore, we conduct a decomposition of the relaxation structure in terms of the two main classes of interstitial configurations.

item.statement: The authors propose applying the same entropy-stabilization alloy design strategy to develop other high-damping high-entropy alloys beyond the specific Ta-Nb-Hf-Zr-Ti system.
quotes: Moreover, the current alloy design strategy could be used to develop other high-damping HEAs as well (see fig. S2).

The findings not only introduce a class of high-damping materials for engineering applications but also shed light on understanding the mechanisms of mechanical damping in general and specifically at elevated temperatures.
The current findings have important implications not only for developing advanced damping materials but also for broadening the application range of HEAs.
